task.title: Consolidate resume task selection
task.summary: Replace duplicated /wiki-resume and codewiki_resume_context task-selection logic with one shared resolver and parity tests.

goal.outcome: /wiki-resume and codewiki_resume_context share one tested task-selection implementation.
acceptance: A shared module owns resolveImplementationTask and resumeCandidates, plus task artifact scope/blocking helpers where appropriate.
The command adapter and resume-context tool import the shared resolver instead of carrying duplicate functions.
Tests cover explicit task selection, session focus, persisted focus, roadmap-order fallback, artifact conflict skip, and non-executable task skip.
Existing resume prompt, artifact-status, status-dock, and source-root guard behavior remains compatible.
non_goals: Do not redesign roadmap scheduling policy.
Do not rename Pi commands or tool schemas.
